calibration_baseline: V11 Review Agent 90/100; V12 Review Agent 88/100

findings.finding: V12 collapsed 55 metrics to 18 and reused unrelated metric IDs for stitches, components, landmarks, prototype kit and pilot phases.
findings.remediation: Restore the accumulated evidence set and bind each narrative conclusion to its exact recomputable metric; add bilingual semantic assertions.
findings.verification: semantic-qa-v13.js rejects substituted IDs, duplicate paragraph references, unresolved references and bilingual drift.

findings.finding: V12 let a twelve-row measurement table displace the decisive ALT-A/B/C spatial judgement in the actual scoring entrances.
findings.remediation: Restore the reject/revise/advance decision as the primary metrics figure and PDF first-page message; retain only T2, S2 and S7 hero contracts as secondary evidence.
findings.verification: At 1024 px the decision, reason and selected ALT-C are visible without reading a twelve-row table.

findings.finding: The first V13 A0 draft retained low-information areas and did not connect the selected geometry to a spatial experience.
findings.remediation: Rebalance all three boards around one dominant visual and add a generated ALT-C experience view tied to the public cross, one-sided trial bay, staffed receipt porch and removal route.
findings.verification: Final A0 contact-sheet review shows denser single-focus boards; the experience image is explicitly non-field evidence and vector geometry remains authoritative.

findings.finding: Official survey, ownership, station entrances, statutory controls, utilities and observed flows remain unavailable.
findings.remediation: Keep dimensions and boundaries provisional and rerun the audit when formal data arrives.

findings.finding: No scene has been field-run; safety, traffic, satisfaction, cost and recovery time remain unknown.
findings.remediation: Do not issue adopt/revise/stop until baseline and controlled field evidence exist.

findings.finding: Public OSM context is incomplete around the prototype.
findings.remediation: Show low-confidence context and verify building edges professionally before implementation.

findings.finding: Automated in-app browser control rejects file:// navigation, so runtime visual interaction was not automatically asserted.
findings.remediation: Keep static offline dependency QA as passed and require the user to perform the final local runtime visual review before any Ready PR.
